title: ONE PROMPT AT A TIME
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid reads like a shooter HUD. With a door he held the key for and a crate both in reach, both prompts said [E] and E did the door first; beside a downed pillager, a survivor and a crate it was three [E] prompts at once. Only the prompt for the target a held E acts on is drawn now, in the order the game itself takes E: a door he has the key for, the seal, a downed teammate, a downed pillager, the survivor, the Peddler, the ring he stands in, then the crate. A locked door with no key still shows LOCKED, and inside a ring the search prompt still names X, its own key.
now: Only one E prompt is drawn at a time, the one a held E acts on.
